annotation.title_clean: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines unveiled to position Mauritius as a high-tech, innovation-driven economy
annotation.title_en: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines unveiled to position Mauritius as a high-tech, innovation-driven economy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation, Mauritius (source: Government Information Service)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation (mitci.govmu.org)
annotation.summary_en: Government news release on the April 2026 launch of Mauritius' National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines (Fairness, Accountability, Inclusiveness and Integrity, Responsibility), plus the AI Unit website, Regional AI Marketplace and other digital initiatives. General AI policy with no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines launched to guide ethical, transparent AI adoption in Mauritius
FAIR guidelines grounded in fairness, accountability, inclusiveness, integrity and responsibility
AI Unit website and Regional AI Marketplace unveiled
Provisions being made to facilitate startup registration and safeguard the local AI industry
